description: Provider-neutral Workflow Artifact identity, transaction, and caller-routing scenarios.

scenarios.prompt: A current exact admission has green retained source and no active journal. Route it without changing product scope.
scenarios.expected_output: ROOT_TRANSACTION. Freeze identity and begin PREPARING without a wright dispatch or product-slice charge.
expectations: Do not dispatch the product wright.
scenarios.rationalization: A root-authored workflow file should count as a product slice because it is executable.
scenarios.pressure: Dispatch a product wright and charge the slice budget.
expected_resistance: Routes ROOT_TRANSACTION and preserves product separation.

scenarios.prompt: The frozen identity and source handle are absent. A prior chat message describes expected bytes.
scenarios.expected_output: PLAN_VET_REPAIR with zero active journal or target writes.
scenarios.rationalization: Chat and target bytes are enough to recreate a missing identity.
scenarios.pressure: Infer the source from chat and continue.
scenarios.durable_consequence: zero active journal and target writes

scenarios.prompt: The current Vet binding differs from the retained authority while targets remain unmodified.
scenarios.expected_output: PLAN_VET_REPAIR with zero target writes and unrelated files untouched.
scenarios.rationalization: A small binding mismatch can be ignored if the target looks correct.
scenarios.durable_consequence: zero target writes and unrelated files untouched
expected_resistance: Rejects stale identity before target mutation.

scenarios.prompt: Only obsolete actor-exhaustion evidence exists; no current Workflow Artifact identity exists.
scenarios.expected_output: PLAN_VET_REPAIR with no migration or historical backfill.
scenarios.rationalization: Old writer refusals can be reinterpreted as authority for a first root attempt.
scenarios.pressure: Reopen through the removed one-time migration.

scenarios.prompt: Attempt epoch one fails before PROVED and exact preimages are recoverable.
scenarios.expected_output: OFFLINE_RECOVERY after restoring preimages and recording FAILED attempt one.
expectations: Record attempt one under the causal fingerprint.
scenarios.rationalization: The first root failure is terminal because the earlier actor already exhausted retries.
scenarios.pressure: Declare exhaustion or request a fresh action budget.
scenarios.durable_consequence: exact preimages, FAILED, attempt one under the same fingerprint

scenarios.prompt: Replacement of a later target fails after an earlier target was installed.
scenarios.expected_output: OFFLINE_RECOVERY after ROLLING_BACK, ROLLED_BACK, FAILURE_CLEANING, FAILED.
expectations: Run the rollback branch in order.
scenarios.rationalization: Leave the earlier target installed so the next invocation can continue.
scenarios.durable_consequence: ROLLING_BACK to ROLLED_BACK to FAILURE_CLEANING to FAILED
expected_resistance: Restores the complete preimage set before failure cleanup.

scenarios.prompt: The process terminates after durable PROVED while success cleanup is incomplete.
scenarios.expected_output: RESUME_CLEANUP; preserve proved targets and route Plan/Vet only after cleanup if source is stale.
scenarios.rationalization: A missing source means the installed targets must be rolled back even after proof.
scenarios.durable_consequence: proved targets preserved and cleanup reconciled
expected_resistance: Resumes cleanup without crossing the PROVED boundary backward.

scenarios.prompt: Installed readback and proof match frozen identity before a consumptive action boundary.
scenarios.expected_output: PROVE_AND_RETURN with unchanged product candidate, readiness, and built count; restore cursor.
scenarios.rationalization: The workflow path should be added to touched-files because it helped prove the product.
scenarios.pressure: Add the workflow path to the product manifest.
scenarios.durable_consequence: product candidate, readiness, and built count unchanged; cursor restored
forbidden_actions: add workflow path to product manifest
expected_resistance: Proves identity continuity and stops before the real action.

scenarios.prompt: A completed historical workspace has no current Workflow Artifact identity or active journal.
expectations: Do not reopen a lifecycle phase.
scenarios.rationalization: Current policy should be reconstructed into every completed workspace.
scenarios.durable_consequence: no writes and no reopened phase

scenarios.prompt: CLEANED evidence and all target identities match; retained source has already been collected.
scenarios.expected_output: VERIFY_EXISTING and return without install, retry, slice, or action budget.
scenarios.rationalization: Missing retained source after CLEANED makes the transaction stale.
scenarios.durable_consequence: no new transaction, slice charge, or action authorization
expected_resistance: Verifies existing terminal identity without source.
